children: The euro could stay weak due to the political turmoil in France and the geopolitical tensions between Ukraine and Russia, Convera's market insights team say in a note. These challenges could limit the scope for a sustained rally, the team says. "With euro shorts already heavily stretched, near-term rallies may remain corrective rather than signal a durable change in trend." The euro trades flat versus dollar at $1.1089 and rises 0.1% versus sterling to 0.8359 pounds. Euro hit an 18-month low of $1.1065 overnight, LSEG data show. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
